machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

artifact.mapping: One read-only page-aligned no-copy Metal buffer

method.reference: Pinned official AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 FP32 execution on MPS
method.native: FP32 HWC activations, OIHW checkpoint weights, FP32 Metal accumulation with fast math disabled
method.small_case: Deterministic BF16-rounded [1,64,1,1,1] latent with 35 internal/output comparisons
method.production_case: Committed scheduler step-40 [1,64,1,16,16] latent decoded to [1,4,1,256,256]
method.still_image_semantics: One cached first chunk: causal convolution folds away time, upsample3d skips time_conv, DupUp3D shortcut retains its exact first-frame mapping

simdgroup_64x64_optimization.reason: A dispatch-level profile attributed about 2.23 seconds of the 2.25-second decoder GPU total to convolution; batching the 112 command buffers could only address the much smaller wall-minus-GPU remainder.
simdgroup_64x64_optimization.implementation: Implicit NHWC convolution as a 64x64 FP32 cooperative-matrix tile. Sixteen SIMD groups reuse a gathered 64x32 input tile and a transposed 32x64 weight tile without materializing im2col; operands, accumulation, and output remain FP32. The production-only unused no-SiLU final norm was also removed.

integrated_blue_teapot.end_to_end_comparison_note: The text phase varied from the 12674 ms baseline to 15493 ms in this run, so the 35528 ms total is not a controlled whole-process speed comparison; the transformer loop remained normal at 12516 ms.

interpretation: The model-scale output agrees closely enough to use arithmetic-error gates far tighter than the mixed-transformer runtime. The independently captured small boundaries make the unusual first-chunk shortcut semantics observable instead of relying only on final pixels.
limitations: This validates the pinned still-image first-chunk path only; temporal continuation and tiled decode are not implemented.
The command is a decoder validation boundary, not yet a user-facing generation pipeline or image writer.
Summed GPU time excludes Safetensors parsing, Metal source compilation, fixture I/O, and process startup; each kernel still uses a separate command buffer and synchronous wait.
The 1.258 GiB FP32 VAE checkpoint is mapped without copying, but is not quantized.
Native prompt encoding remains a separate later boundary.
